lines.text: Structured exploration of questions that matter.
True inquiry requires humility, not knowing in advance; curiosity, a genuine desire to understand; mutuality, both parties as explorers; and patience, letting understanding emerge.
Ask with genuine curiosity. Keep the question clear and focused. Avoid loading the question with assumptions.
Both parties pause before responding. Notice first reactions and look deeper. Consider multiple angles.
Speak from authentic understanding. Include uncertainty where present. Offer what you genuinely have.
The responder asks a related question back. This can challenge, expand, or redirect. Maintains mutual exploration.
Both parties name what shifted. Acknowledge new understanding. Appreciate the journey together.
